about.heading: Our Heritage
body: Since 2008, we have combined masterful stone craftsmanship with compassionate support.
We guide you through every step—from dignified ceremonies to lasting memorials.
Transparent pricing. Respectful care. Enduring quality.
about.title: About the Company
about.lead: We combine calm guidance, precise stone craftsmanship, and a clear process for families who want a dignified result without unnecessary stress.
points: We work with granite memorials, installation, and full memorial site improvement.
Options are explained clearly so families can choose with confidence and within budget.
The process is kept understandable from the first conversation to final installation.

items.question: How long does production take?
items.answer: Usually 2 to 6 weeks depending on complexity, season, and selected material.

items.question: What documents are required?
items.answer: For the initial consultation, basic information is enough. For cemetery installation we help clarify required documents for the specific location.

items.question: Is installment payment available?
items.answer: Yes, installment plans are available for some orders. Final terms are agreed individually during quotation.

items.question: Do you work across all Estonia?
items.answer: Yes, we accept and complete orders across Estonia.
